t: The Controller is the heart of an XNet network. It edits channels and decides how items, fluids, energy, or redstone move through connected blocks.
控制器是XNet网络的核心。它负责编辑频道，并决定物品、流体、能量或红石信号如何经由已连接方块进行传输。
Add a channel, choose its type, then add connectors to that channel. Every connector can have its own side, priority, filters, and transfer settings.
添加一个通道，选择其类型，再向该通道添加连接器。每个连接器均可独立设置侧面、优先级、过滤器及传输参数。
